# Coding-AI Prompt: Complete Landing Page — Aptos Network Style Reference

## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE TO ENFORCE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- Keep all styling strictly inside `style.css`. Forbid `style="..."` attributes in HTML. Target all design via class/ID selectors. Keep HTML clean, semantic, and agnostic of visual styling.

**1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens**
Store all tokens in `:root` (and theme classes) using CSS variables. Required tokens:
- Colors: `--color-ink: #0f0e0b`, `--color-bone: #f9f9f0`, `--color-ash: #6d6c67`, `--color-charcoal: #21201c`, `--color-graphite: #555450`, `--color-mist: #84837d`, `--color-deep-earth: #3d3b34`, `--color-soft-sand: #ccc5a3`, `--color-warm-stone: #9d937c`, `--color-sage: #d5fad3`, `--color-powder-blue: #badbee`.
- Contrast pairing: light backgrounds pair with dark text (`--color-ink`); dark surfaces pair with light text (`--color-bone`). Enforce for every theme.
- Light mode background must not be pure white; use `#fefefe` where near-white is needed (here the canvas is `#f9f9f0`).
- Radius/shadows: `--radius-pill: 9999px`, `--radius-none: 0px`; shadows `--shadow-subtle`, `--shadow-subtle-2`, `--shadow-subtle-3` as inset hairlines.
- Spacing: `--spacing-5,10,15,20,30,40,45,50,60,90,150,180`.
- Transitions: `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`.
- Elevation: `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.
- Typography: `--font-base` bound to Season Serif (substitute Google Font "Source Serif 4" or "Newsreader" with variable weights), `--font-mono` for code panels (use a monospace Google Font such as "JetBrains Mono" or "IBM Plex Mono").
- Type scale tokens: `--text-body-sm`, `--text-body`, `--text-subheading`, `--text-heading`, `--text-heading-lg`, `--text-display-sm`, `--text-display` per spec.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Provide dark mode tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class selector. Switch background/text variables seamlessly. Persist user choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Include a visible toggle with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label`.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build layouts with Flexbox. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless explicitly justified. Mobile-responsive out of the box (rows → columns), no horizontal scrolling.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
- Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS via `@layer`/`@apply`) unless another framework requested. Utility classes map to CSS variables or reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Use Google Fonts for text and icons. Text: Source Serif 4 or Newsreader (variable serif) bound to `--font-base`; monospace for code via Google Font. Icons: Google Material Symbols/Icons. Forbid raw inline SVGs or local icon files.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS TO ENFORCE

**2.1 Button Component Requirements**
- Default: flex, `align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem`, min touch target 44x44px.
- Hover: brightness/shadow shift, `cursor: pointer`.
- Focus: distinct focus ring via CSS variables.
- Active/Pressed: `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- Loading: disable interactions, prevent double-clicks, render CSS spinner or animated Google Icon without distorting dimensions.
- Disabled: `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- Success/Error: temporary feedback via `--text-success`/`--text-error`.
- Pill CTA style: Charcoal fill, Bone text, weight 420, 16px, 10px 20px padding, 9999px radius, uppercase, no border/shadow.
- Ghost link: no bg/border, Ink text, weight 400, 16px, underline on hover only, 5px vertical padding.

**2.2 Card Component Requirements**
- Default: flex layout, subtle borders/elevation via `--bg-secondary` and CSS variables.
- Hover: elevation/shadow shift or `transform: translateY(-2px)`.
- Focus-within: highlight borders when child link/button focused.
- Loading (Skeleton): shimmer animation in CSS, no layout jumps.
- Empty State: Google Icon + guidance text.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements**
- States: Empty, Focused (outline ring), Filled, Valid (success border/icon), Invalid (error border, red text, error icon), Disabled, Read-only.
- Structure: flex container wrapping label, input, dedicated error feedback container. Inputs radius 0px.

**2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements**
- States: Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing (CSS transitions).
- UX: centered flex (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay, Google Icon close button, keyboard focus trapping, close via Esc or overlay click.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES TO ENFORCE

- Responsive by default, fluid sizing, no horizontal overflow.
- Smooth animations via `transition: var(--transition-normal)`, respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Accessibility: sufficient contrast both modes, never rely solely on color, semantic HTML5, correct ARIA roles/labels, logical focus order, full keyboard operability, `aria-live` for dynamic feedback.
- Mandatory visual feedback on every click/hover/submission.
- Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.

## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

- File structure: separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` beyond single deferred entry-point reference.
- Naming: one consistent convention (BEM or fixed utility set) across entire deliverable; never mix.
- No unrequested placeholders; placeholders only where content genuinely unspecified.

## 5. BRAND & CONTENT RULES (MANDATORY)

- Reuse the visual style only. Invent a fictional brand name, product, and copy. Never use the real brand name "Aptos", its logo, trademarks, or product names anywhere in the page.
- All user-facing copy must be in English.

## 6. THEME-SPECIFIC STYLE ENFORCEMENT (Aptos Network Reference)

- Sole typeface: Season Serif (substitute Source Serif 4/Newsreader). Fractional weights: 335, 340, 358, 363, 400, 420, 444. No standard 300/400/700.
- Letter spacing: -0.030em at 90px+, -0.020em at 55px, -0.010em at 20–24px, 0 at 16–18px, +0.010em at 9px. Enable `font-feature-settings: "calt"` on all text.
- Full-bleed color sections (Sage/Warm Stone/Soft Sand/Powder Blue) at 90–150px vertical padding; never constrain section backgrounds to max-width.
- Dividers as `inset 0 0 0 1px {color}` box-shadows, not borders. Rotate colors: Ink, Soft Sand, Powder Blue.
- Radius: 9999px for buttons, nav pill, tags; 0px for all other surfaces (cards, code panels, inputs, images).
- No drop shadows; flat design. No sans-serif. No bright/saturated colors (saturation ≤ 40%). No smooth gradients — hard-edge striped patterns with sharp color stops.
- Split every section ~55/45: left text, right decoration (striped pattern or code panel). Text left-aligned; right side never contains text.
- Striped panels: alternating 44px vertical bands, hard-edge linear-gradient with sharp stops, color pairs Ink+Powder Blue or Ink+Soft Sand, 1px hairline separation, wave/curve mask. Two orientations create weaving effect.
- Section color rotation: Sage (hero) → Warm Stone (body) → Powder Blue (code) → Soft Sand (tonal breaks). Start hero with Sage or body with Warm Stone.
- Page max-width 1280px for inner content; sections full viewport width. Section gap 90–150px. Card padding 30px. Element gap 15–30px.

## 7. LANDING PAGE SECTIONS TO BUILD

Build a complete landing page with these sections in order:
1. **Hero** — Sage full-bleed bg, 150px vertical padding. Display headline weight 335, 120px, Ink, letter-spacing -3.6px, line-height 1.0, left-aligned, two-line max. Filled pill CTA below. Right side: curved striped panel (44px bands Ink + Powder Blue).
2. **Features** — 3 cards (radius 0px, Bone surface, hairline borders). Full-bleed section (Warm Stone or Soft Sand). Left text / right decoration split.
3. **How It Works** — 3 steps. Full-bleed section. Numbered steps with hairline dividers.
4. **Testimonials** — Full-bleed section. Quote blocks with hairline borders, no cards radius.
5. **Pricing** — 3 tiers. Full-bleed section. Tier cards radius 0px, hairline borders, filled pill CTA on primary tier.
6. **FAQ** — Full-bleed section. Accordion items with hairline dividers, expand/collapse via CSS.
7. **Final CTA** — Full-bleed section (Sage or Charcoal Stamp). Display headline + filled pill CTA.
8. **Footer** — Bone canvas background. Secondary links, hairline top border, nav-pill style links.

## 8. OUTPUT

Output only the finished prompt itself, no preamble or closing commentary. Mirror the structure above. Ensure all rules from Sections 1–4 hold. If any request conflicts with a mandatory rule, keep the rule and add a one-line explicit exception clause.
